battle.name: 反奉戰爭
battle.brief: 反奉戰爭是奉系將領郭松齡於一九二五年十一月起兵反抗張作霖的軍事衝突，戰場集中於奉天省，進軍方向直指瀋陽。當時地面部隊配備包括早在一八四〇年已列裝的法國 Percussion rifle（雷管步槍），用以支援步兵作戰。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管步槍是法國陸軍十九世紀中期配置於步兵單位的制式步槍，隸屬營內步兵排與連的地面火力，並非炮兵或航空裝備。

countries: 「反奉戰爭」不是兩個主權國家之間的戰爭，而是中華民國中央名義仍存、實際由北洋軍閥分割的國內戰爭。奉系一方以張作霖為首，依據奉天、吉林、黑龍江，並在1924年入北京後掌握中央政府的軍事影響；反奉一方則由吳佩孚的北方軍及齊燮元、馬聯甲等直系地方軍構成。山東督軍孫傳芳在1925年初脫離張作霖並加入反奉陣線，因此他既是反奉聯軍的發動者之一，也是後來在山東與奉軍正面決戰的一方。主要戰場沿山東、直隸、北京至天津軸線及蘇北一帶展開；京奉路、津浦路、膠濟路和黃河渡口決定了多數進退，外國售械則不等於外國參戰。戰史分期並不一致：普遍以六月上旬吳佩孚通電討奉為全面開戰點，也有表格把八月四日至十一月一日列為主要戰期，而一月二十六日孫傳芳在山東公開脫奉則應視為前奏。
countriesEn: The Anti-Fengtian War was not a war between two sovereign states, but a domestic conflict within a nominal Republic of China whose central authority had in practice been divided among Beiyang warlords. The Fengtian side was led by Zhang Zuolin, based in Fengtian, Jilin and Heilongjiang and, after entering Beijing in 1924, dominant over the central government’s military decisions. The anti-Fengtian side consisted of Wu Peifu’s Northern Army together with the regional forces of Zhili commanders such as Qi Xieyuan and Ma Lianjia. Shandong governor Sun Chuanfang broke with Zhang Zuolin in early 1925 and joined the anti-Fengtian alignment, making him both one of the movement’s initiators and, later, the commander who fought the Fengtian armies directly in Shandong. The principal theaters extended across Shandong, Zhili, the Beijing–Tianjin axis and northern Jiangsu. The Beijing–Shanhaiguan, Tianjin–Pukou and Jiaozhou–Jinan railways, together with the crossings of the Yellow River, repeatedly determined movement and withdrawal; foreign arms sales did not make foreign states belligerents. Historical dating varies: many accounts treat Wu Peifu’s telegram in early June as the start of the full war, while some tabulate 4 August to 1 November as the main campaign. Sun Chuanfang’s public break with Zhang Zuolin in Shandong on 26 January is best treated as the prelude.
people: 張作霖是奉方的最高決策者，奉軍實際上分成若干個「軍」，軍下再混編師、旅及步兵、炮兵、騎兵，番號和任務在戰期內曾多次調整。先後統率奉軍各路的主要將領包括楊玉亭、張學良、臧洪宇、張作相、于學忠，奉系在山東的張宗昌所部亦參與作戰；其中張學良、臧洪宇所指揮的山東方向縱隊，對奉軍切斷膠濟路並取得濟南具有重要作用。反奉聯軍則是吳佩孚的北方軍、齊燮元所部江蘇軍、馬聯甲所部安徽軍及孫傳芳山東軍拼合而成：吳佩孚著重overall戰略與北方主戰線，齊、馬各自保存地方軍政利益，孫傳芳雖率先反奉，卻沒有因此成為吳佩孚的單純附屬。雙方都沒有現代意義上的統一戰區指揮，奉軍各路常須協調接戰，反奉聯軍則更容易因命令互不銜接而各自作戰。因此，戰役中的實際指揮權不能只從「軍」「師」等番號推斷，也不宜把後來形成的部隊沿革倒置到1925年的戰鬥之中。
peopleEn: Zhang Zuolin was the senior decision-maker on the Fengtian side. The Fengtian forces were divided into several armies, beneath which divisions, brigades and mixed infantry, artillery and cavalry formations were arranged; designations and assignments changed repeatedly during the campaign. The principal commanders who successively led Fengtian columns included Yang Yuting, Zhang Xueliang, Zang Hongyu, Zhang Zuoxiang and Yu Xuezhong, while Zhang Zongchang’s forces in Shandong also took part. Zhang Xueliang’s and Zang Hongyu’s columns operating toward Shandong were particularly important in cutting the Jiaozhou–Jinan railway and taking Jinan. The anti-Fengtian coalition was a patchwork combining Wu Peifu’s Northern Army, Qi Xieyuan’s Jiangsu forces, Ma Lianjia’s Anhui forces and Sun Chuanfang’s Shandong army. Wu Peifu concentrated on overall strategy and the northern main front; Qi and Ma preserved their own regional interests; and Sun, although first to rise against the Fengtians, did not become a simple subordinate of Wu. Neither side possessed a unified modern theater command. Fengtian columns often had to coordinate while making contact, and the anti-Fengtian coalition was more vulnerable to disconnected orders and separate decisions. Actual command authority therefore cannot be reconstructed from labels such as army or division alone, and later organizational histories should not be projected backward into the fighting of 1925.
kits: 1925年以前已為中國軍隊採用、並可在華北軍隊中找到的裝備，來源並不統一。步槍主要包括漢陽八八式步槍和日本三八式步槍，前者使用7.92×57毫米子彈，後者使用6.5×50毫米R子彈；輕重機槍可見Schwarzlose M1907/12輕機槍及Maxim M1910水冷重機槍。炮兵方面，日式八八式75毫米野戰炮、日式七五式75毫米山炮、Schneider M1908式75毫米山炮及英式十八磅野戰炮，都是當時已存在的真實型號。75毫米口徑並不代表炮彈可以通用：野戰炮與山炮採用不同炮彈設計，英式十八磅炮的膛徑和彈藥系統亦不同；6.5毫米與7.92毫米步槍彈藥同樣不能混用，這直接增加了後勤分發的難度。現存軍械清冊不完整，不能斷言某一型槍械由哪一支部隊獨家使用，也不能把某一門炮的規格套給全軍。ZB-26輕機槍於1920年代後期才出現，日式九七式90毫米迫擊炮亦在1925年後才列裝，故不應拿來描寫本戰役。
kitsEn: The equipment adopted by Chinese forces before 1925 and capable of being encountered by armies in North China came from several different sources. Rifles chiefly included the Hanyuan Type 88 rifle and the Japanese Type 38 rifle; the former used 7.92×57 mm ammunition and the latter 6.5×50 mmR. Light and heavy machine guns included the Schwarzlose M1907/12 light machine gun and the Maxim M1910 water-cooled heavy machine gun. For artillery, the Japanese Type 88 75 mm field gun, Japanese Type 75 75 mm mountain gun, Schneider M1908 75 mm mountain gun and British 18-pounder field gun were all real weapons already in service by that time. A common 75 mm bore did not make shells interchangeable: field-gun and mountain-gun ammunition differed in design, while the British 18-pounder also had a different bore and ammunition system. Likewise, 6.5 mm and 7.92 mm rifle ammunition could not be mixed, directly complicating distribution. Surviving ordnance inventories are incomplete, so it would be unsafe to assign a particular weapon exclusively to one formation or apply one gun’s specifications to an entire army. The ZB-26 light machine gun appeared only in the late 1920s, and the Japanese Type 97 90 mm mortar was not adopted until after 1925; neither should be used to describe this war.
tactics: 作戰上的第一個關鍵是控制鐵路，而不是立即求取城市。奉軍由東北沿京奉路南下，利用山海關至天津的通道輸送部隊，再由天津向德州、徐州方向施壓；山東方向的奉軍則控制膠濟路北段及濟南以北，使孫傳芳的山東軍、齊燮元的江蘇軍和馬聯甲的安徽軍難以在同一時間會合。戰鬥中常見的做法是先以炮兵測量射界，再以機槍封鎖道路、橋梁、鐵路路基和渡口，步兵在掩護火力下分批接近突破口，預備隊則在第一線受挫後投入；奪取據點以後， troops 才以縱隊或散兵線追擊退兵。孫傳芳部曾利用既有城防、鐵路沿線陣地和黃河兩側進行固守與局部反擊，奉軍則較常在取得鐵路樞紐後集中兵力作縱深攻勢。天津外圍的交戰同樣受鐵路和道路限制，直軍利用路堤、營壘與炮兵對抗奉軍，奉軍則由東北方向持續壓迫。這不是摩托化的閃電戰：主要火力仍是步槍、機槍、馬匹牽引火炮及鐵路運輸，部隊命令依靠電話、電報和騎馬傳令。彈藥由後方兵站分送至軍、旅，再以火藥車、炮車和畜力車轉運；炮彈、引信、步槍彈、備件、馬匹飼料和道路維修都會拖慢攻勢。道路破壞、渡口擁塞、彈藥基數不足及馬匹消耗，經常迫使指揮官在攻勢與補給之間停頓。
tacticsEn: The first operational priority was control of the railways rather than immediate possession of cities. The Fengtian forces moved south from the northeast along the Beijing–Shanhaiguan route, using the line from Shanhaiguan to Tianjin to sustain movement and then pressing toward Dezhou and Xuzhou. Their columns in Shandong took control of the northern Jiaozhou–Jinan railway and the ground north of Jinan, making it difficult for Sun Chuanfang’s Shandong forces, Qi Xieyuan’s Jiangsu troops and Ma Lianjia’s Anhui troops to join in support of one another. A common tactical sequence was for artillery to range its targets, machine guns to cover roads, bridges, railway embankments and river crossings, infantry to approach supported by those fires, and reserves to be committed after the leading line had been checked. Only after taking a position would troops pursue in column or dispersed order. Sun Chuanfang’s forces used existing fortifications, positions along the railway and both banks of the Yellow River for defense and local counterattack. The Fengtian armies more often concentrated after securing a railway junction and then drove in depth. Fighting outside Tianjin was similarly constrained by the railway and roads: Zhili troops used embankments, camps and artillery positions against Fengtian pressure from the northeast. This was not a motorized blitzkrieg. rifles, machine guns, horse-drawn artillery and rail transport remained the main means of combat and supply, while orders traveled by telephone, telegraph and mounted courier. Ammunition moved from rear depots to armies and brigades, then onward by railcars, gun caissons and draft-animal carts. Artillery shells, fuzes, rifle ammunition, spare parts, animal feed and road maintenance all slowed an advance. Broken roads, congestion at crossings, insufficient ammunition stocks and the loss of draft animals repeatedly forced commanders to pause between attack and resupply.
data: 一月二十六日，孫傳芳在山東公開脫離張作霖一方，奪取省內主動權，成為反奉行動的公開開端；春季，張作霖調集奉軍入關，山東、直隸兩線的衝突隨即擴大。六月四日，吳佩孚通電並部署討奉兵力，衝突由孫傳芳與奉軍的山東戰爭升級為直奉全面戰爭，因此六月四日可視為全面開戰點；部分戰史把八月四日至十一月一日列作正式戰期，差別主要在是否把前期倒戈和動員算入。六月下旬至夏季，奉軍利用山海關、北京及天津間的鐵路轉運兵員，向山東施加壓力，山東方向的奉軍同時威脅膠濟路和濟南；孫傳芳在魯北與膠濟路沿線失去主動，部隊退向魯南及蘇北方向，齊、馬兩部則未能建立連續的協同戰線。九月前後，奉軍控制濟南及膠濟路中段，山東戰線至此基本定型；與此同時，奉軍由北面和東面壓向天津外圍，直軍的北方軍正面受到衝擊，局部反擊未能扭轉局面。十月是兩個主要戰線最接近決定性的階段：山東戰線向魯南、蘇北延伸，天津外圍則以軍、師為單位反覆攻守。十一月初，主要戰線停止大規模交戰，十一月一日是文獻最常用的停戰日期，但各方命令傳達及局部脫離接觸並非完全同步。孫傳芳退出山東控制，奉系張宗昌的權力在山東擴大；吳佩孚的北方軍則失去山東與北直隴的戰略樞紐。現存各方戰報常只列俘虜、槍械、馬匹或奪占地，陣亡、失聯、疾病和戰俘統計口徑不一，故沒有可信的全戰總傷亡數字可用。
dataEn: On 26 January, Sun Chuanfang publicly broke with Zhang Zuolin in Shandong and seized the initiative within the province, becoming the public beginning of the anti-Fengtian movement. During the spring, Zhang Zuolin concentrated Fengtian troops inside the Great Wall, and the conflict expanded across the Shandong and Zhili fronts. On 4 June, Wu Peifu telegraphed his anti-Fengtian deployment; the struggle between Sun and the Fengtian armies in Shandong consequently became a full Zhili–Fengtian war. June 4 can therefore serve as the general opening date, although some histories list 4 August to 1 November as the formal campaign, depending on whether the earlier rebellion and mobilization are included. From late June through the summer, the Fengtian forces used the railways connecting Shanhaiguan, Beijing and Tianjin to move troops and exert pressure on Shandong. Their Shandong columns simultaneously threatened the Jiaozhou–Jinan railway and Jinan. Sun lost the initiative in northern Shandong and along that railway, withdrawing toward southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu, while Qi’s and Ma’s forces failed to establish a continuous coordinated front. Around September, the Fengtian armies controlled Jinan and the central section of the Jiaozhou–Jinan railway, effectively deciding the Shandong front. At the same time, they pressed toward the approaches to Tianjin from the north and east, placing the Zhili Northern Army under heavy frontal pressure; local counterattacks did not reverse the situation. October was the closest either major front came to a decision. The Shandong fighting extended into southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu, while outside Tianjin armies and divisions repeatedly attacked and defended. In early November, the principal fronts ceased large-scale combat. 1 November is the most commonly used date for the ceasefire, although orders reached formations and local separations from contact were not perfectly simultaneous. Sun Chuanfang lost control of Shandong, Zhang Zongchang’s Fengtian authority expanded there, and Wu Peifu’s Northern Army lost the strategic pivots of Shandong and northern Zhili. Contemporary reports often list only prisoners, weapons, horses or captured ground, while their standards for deaths, missing men, disease and captivity differed. No reliable aggregate casualty figure for the entire war is therefore available.
cause: 反奉戰爭的根源是1924年直奉戰爭後形成的權力格局。張作霖的奉系進入北京，取得中央政府的軍事優勢，卻不可能立即解散吳佩孚、齊燮元、馬聯甲和孫傳芳各自掌握的軍隊與地盤；直系各方則希望削弱奉系在北京及北方各省的控制。山東是矛盾的集中點：孫傳芳需要保有省軍、省政、膠濟路及相關稅收，奉系則要維持張宗昌等人在魯的勢力，並使山東軍隊接受奉系的編制和調度。孫傳芳在一月二十六日脫奉，使這一矛盾由 latent rivalry 變成公開衝突。吳佩孚隨後利用直系地方軍反對奉系控制的共同意願，聯絡齊燮元、馬聯甲及孫傳芳，形成對北京與奉軍的包圍意圖；齊、馬也擔心 themselves 成為下一個被奉系削弱的對象。因而，開戰並非源於單一事故或一份可以核實的秘密命令，而是中央軍政權力、山東控制權、地方軍生存和鐵路資源分配同時惡化的結果。
causeEn: The roots of the Anti-Fengtian War lay in the power structure that followed the 1924 Zhili–Fengtian War. The Fengtian forces under Zhang Zuolin entered Beijing and gained military predominance over the central government, but they could not immediately disband the separate armies and territories held by Wu Peifu, Qi Xieyuan, Ma Lianjia and Sun Chuanfang. The Zhili commanders in turn sought to reduce Fengtian influence in Beijing and the northern provinces. Shandong concentrated the contradictions. Sun Chuanfang needed to retain the provincial army and government, the Jiaozhou–Jinan railway and the revenue attached to them; the Fengtian side sought to preserve the position of men such as Zhang Zongchang in Shandong and bring the provincial forces under Fengtian organization and deployment. Sun’s break with Zhang Zuolin on 26 January turned a latent rivalry into open conflict. Wu Peifu then used the common desire of Zhili regional commanders to resist Fengtian control, coordinating with Qi Xieyuan, Ma Lianjia and Sun Chuanfang in an effort to encircle Beijing and the Fengtian armies. Qi and Ma also feared becoming the next regional forces reduced by the Fengtian side. The war therefore did not arise from a single incident or a verifiable secret order. It resulted from the simultaneous deterioration of central military authority, control of Shandong, the survival of regional armies and the distribution of railway resources.
impact: 戰爭的首先影響，是奉系取得山東的軍政與鐵路資源，濟南、膠濟路以及通往德州的交通線重新置於張作霖一方控制之下，北京政府的實際軍政影響力也隨之進一步向奉系傾斜。反奉聯軍則失去共同目標：齊燮元與馬聯甲保住各自的地方軍政地位，吳佩孚的北方軍退出山東和北直隴的主要戰區，日後轉向兩湖方向布置兵力；孫傳芳雖然在山東失敗，仍保有相當實力，退回東南後於1926年成為五省聯軍的核心人物之一。張作霖在戰後以安國軍名目整編奉軍，張學良因山東戰線的經歷躋身核心，張宗昌在山東的權力也進一步擴張。這場戰爭同時暴露了兩個問題：進口槍炮不能取代統帥、幕僚、通信和後勤的整體配合；鐵路能迅速集中兵力，卻也會把補給線和指揮中斷一併帶入前線。奉系的勝利鞏固了北方的分裂格局，沒有消除北洋各軍閥的軍隊，反而使下一輪政治與軍事對抗更為逼近。
impactEn: The first effect of the war was that the Fengtian side obtained Shandong’s military, governmental and railway resources. Jinan, the Jiaozhou–Jinan line and the transport routes toward Dezhou once again came under Zhang Zuolin’s control, and the central government’s effective military and political authority tilted further toward the Fengtian clique. The anti-Fengtian coalition lost its common purpose. Qi Xieyuan and Ma Lianjia retained their own regional positions, while Wu Peifu’s Northern Army withdrew from the principal theaters in Shandong and northern Zhili and subsequently based its strength toward the Two Lakes region. Sun Chuanfang, although defeated in Shandong, still preserved substantial forces; after withdrawing to the southeast, he became one of the central figures in the Five Provinces Alliance of 1926. Zhang Zuolin reorganized the Fengtian forces under the name of the Anguo Army after the war. Zhang Xueliang entered the inner circle through his conduct of the Shandong campaign, and Zhang Zongchang’s authority in Shandong expanded further. The conflict also exposed two realities: imported rifles and artillery could not replace unified command, staff work, communications and logistics; and railways could concentrate troops rapidly, but they also carried supply-line failures and command interruptions directly to the front. The Fengtian victory consolidated the fragmented military order in North China rather than eliminating the Beiyang warlords’ armies, bringing the next cycle of political and military confrontation closer.
result: 結果是奉系取得明確的軍事與政治勝利，但這不是一場把敵軍全部消滅的決戰。反奉聯軍在山東首先崩解：孫傳芳放棄山東控制，魯北、膠濟路與濟南歸入奉軍體系，張宗昌成為張作霖控制山東的主要代理人；齊燮元、馬聯甲的部隊則退回各自勢力範圍，聯盟形式實際消失。吳佩孚未能摧毀北京方面的奉軍，北方軍在天津外圍受挫後退往南直隸及兩湖，與齊、馬、孫的協同作戰宣告終止。奉軍由東北南下控制山東，並鞏固對北京政府的軍政主導，卻沒有把全國軍隊統一到自己的指揮系統內。十一月一日前後的停戰安排主要處理停火、脫離接觸與各地職權歸屬，並非一份能消除所有軍閥矛盾的總和條約。孫傳芳仍有軍隊，吳佩孚仍保有直系核心，奉系內部各軍及各省權力也繼續發展。因此，1925年的反奉戰爭以奉系控制山東、直系北方軍失去北方樞紐而告終；它改變了力量配置，沒有解決北洋政治。
resultEn: The result was a clear military and political victory for the Fengtian clique, although it was not a battle that annihilated the enemy. The anti-Fengtian alliance first disintegrated on the Shandong front. Sun Chuanfang abandoned control of Shandong; northern Shandong, the Jiaozhou–Jinan railway and Jinan entered the Fengtian system, and Zhang Zongchang became the principal agent through whom Zhang Zuolin controlled the province. The forces of Qi Xieyuan and Ma Lianjia returned to their own spheres, and the coalition ceased to exist in practice. Wu Peifu failed to destroy the Fengtian armies around Beijing. After setbacks outside Tianjin, the Northern Army withdrew toward southern Zhili and the Two Lakes, and its coordinated operations with Qi, Ma and Sun ended. The Fengtian forces had moved south from the northeast to control Shandong and consolidated their military and political predominance over the Beijing government, but they did not bring all national forces under a single command. The cease-fire arrangements around 1 November principally addressed a cessation of hostilities, separation of forces and the restoration of local administrative powers; they did not constitute a comprehensive settlement capable of removing every warlord conflict. Sun Chuanfang retained troops, Wu Peifu retained the core of the Zhili army, and the Fengtian armies and provincial powers continued to develop their own interests. The Anti-Fengtian War therefore ended with Fengtian control of Shandong and the loss by the Zhili Northern Army of its northern strategic pivots. It altered the distribution of power without resolving Beiyang politics.
